highres_real_false_positives.description: Authentic 8K/12K DSLR photographs misclassified as FULL_AIGC or PARTIAL_AIGC due to optical bokeh / smooth out-of-focus background patches
highres_real_false_positives.root_cause: On 24MP+ images, a 512px crop covers <8% of the image. Natural depth-of-field blur (bokeh) produces low-gradient, high-smoothness patches that mimic generative AI diffusion without sensor noise cues.
highres_real_false_positives.remediation: Add Absolute Megapixel & Sensor Resolution Conditioning, High-Frequency Residual Texture Analysis, and Resolution-Aware Reliability Thresholding.

soft_aigc_false_negatives.description: Photorealistic synthetic images with smooth shading, soft lighting, and low high-frequency artifacting misclassified as REAL

soft_aigc_false_negatives.root_cause: State-of-the-art generators (Midjourney v6, Flux.1, SDXL Turbo) produce photorealistic global composition and smooth skin/sky textures without sharp edge discontinuities.
soft_aigc_false_negatives.remediation: Construct dedicated Soft-AIGC hard positive training pool with specialized patch-level spectral/noise consistency modeling.

hard_real_compression_fpr.root_cause: Lossy JPEG Q40-75 compression, unsharp masking, and Lightroom/CLAHE tone mapping create localized high-frequency edge gradients that trigger false positive patch activations.

partial_ai_localization.remaining_weakness: Small inpaintings (<3% area) on textured backgrounds sometimes fail to reach the 0.50 patch threshold.

remediation_strategy.component_1: High-Resolution Forensic Branch with Absolute Resolution PosEmb & High-Frequency Noise Residuals
remediation_strategy.component_2: Targeted 25,000-sample Remediation Pool (High-Res DSLR + Hard-Real + Soft-AIGC + Subtle Partial-AI)
remediation_strategy.component_3: Resolution-Aware Reliability & Calibrated Operating Thresholds (Target Hard-Real FPR <= 1.0%)
remediation_strategy.component_4: Ambiguity / REVIEW_REQUIRED State for Conflicting Multimodal Evidence
